# Email Marketing Skill for Muse

Plans email marketing end to end for a product or business: EDM vs newsletter (push vs nurture), five content types (onboarding sequences, campaigns, announcements, feature updates, blog/newsletter), deliverability setup (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, dedicated subdomain, Gmail/Yahoo bulk-sender compliance), and measurement (open/click rates, list hygiene, complaint rate under 0.3%). It starts with a quick assessment — goal (retention, conversion, reach), content mix, list size — then gives send cadence, subject-line and CTA best practices, and welcome-series structure. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: written with AI/SaaS products in mind, but the frameworks transfer to any newsletter; the optional "Contextus" context system mentioned in the skill is not required. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
